content.text: The guard was added with the collisionless-only multiplier to handle an all-zero CFL array. Removing it directly would produce `0 * infinity` inside the clamp. Since this build uses `-ffast-math`, relying on `fmin` to clean up that NaN is unsafe; I’m checking a branch-free replacement that preserves the zero-CFL result.
